title: Special Rapporteur concludes starvation-related conduct met an underlying genocidal act
summary: The Special Rapporteur evaluated the siege and deprivation of necessities under the Genocide Convention.
claim: The Special Rapporteur concluded that the nature and scale of the imposed deprivation of food, water, fuel and humanitarian assistance indicated the intentional infliction of conditions of life calculated to bring about the physical destruction of Palestinians as a group.
legal_characterization: Conclusion of an independent UN Special Rapporteur; not an ICJ merits judgment or a criminal conviction.
source_organization: Special Rapporteur on the situation of human rights in the Palestinian territories occupied since 1967
source_title: Anatomy of a Genocide: Report of the Special Rapporteur on the situation of human rights in the Palestinian territories occupied since 1967
verification_notes: Verified against the cited conclusion and attributed specifically to the Special Rapporteur. The mandate holder’s conclusion is not relabeled as a court judgment.
